    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r, c in target), max(r for r, c in target)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r, c in target), max(c for r, c in target)

    # The rightmost non-selector object above the divider is the motif to stack.
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(divider)
              for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1, 2, 5)}
    motif_color = max(colors, key=lambda color: max(
        c for r in range(divider) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color))
    motif = [(r, c) for r in range(divider)
             for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == motif_color]
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in motif), max(r for r, c in motif)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in motif), max(c for r, c in motif)

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(9)]
    # The lower motif is shifted up six rows; the upper motif touches it.
    target_shift = 6
